readme.content:
Solon

Java enterprise application development framework for full scenario
Restrained, Efficient, Open

https://solon.noear.org


##### Language: English | [中文](README_CN.md) | [Русский](README_RU.md) | [日本語](README_JP.md)

700% higher concurrency 50% memory savings Startup is 10 times faster. Packing 90% smaller; It also supports java8 ~ java25, native runtime.
Built from scratch, with more flexible interface specifications and an open ecosystem

## Features: | Feature | Description | |----------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------| | Better cost performance for computing resources | 700% higher concurrency([techempower](https://www.techempower.com/benchmarks/#hw=ph&test=plaintext§ion=data-r23)), 50% memory savings | | Faster development productivity | Less code; Easy to get started; 10x faster startup (faster debugging) | | Better production and deployment experience | Pack 90% smaller | | Greater range of compatibility | Non-java-ee architecture; It also supports java8 ~ java25, graalvm native image | ##
